definition: A neural network architecture designed to operate directly on graph-structured data by passing and aggregating information between connected nodes.
details: GNNs are used in applications ranging from molecule property prediction to recommendation systems and knowledge graph reasoning.
story: Picture an architect laying out a building where every room has to know which other rooms matter to it. Boil it down and it is this: A neural network architecture designed to operate directly on graph-structured data by passing and aggregating information between connected nodes. Here is why it matters: GNNs are used in applications ranging from molecule property prediction to recommendation systems and knowledge graph reasoning. It is the difference between a row of isolated cubicles and one big room where everyone can hear each other. That blueprint is Graph Neural Network.
